meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后,当你需要某个技能时,Claude 会先查询 skills.sh 按安装量排行的列表,再在生态中搜索,核实安装量与来源后推荐可安装的技能,并可用 npx skills add 帮你安装。
howto.when: 当你说“怎么做到某件事”“找找有没有做某事的技能”,或表示想扩展 Claude 的能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个生成 changelog 的技能。
say.note: 会搜索并推荐相关技能及安装命令。

say.text: 有没有做 React 性能优化的技能?
say.note: 会先查排行榜再给出筛选后的推荐。
会用 npx skills add 帮你安装。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you need a skill, Claude checks the skills.sh leaderboard sorted by installs, searches the ecosystem, verifies install counts and sources, then recommends installable skills and can install them via npx skills add.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask how to do something, ask to find a skill for a task, or express interest in extending capabilities.

say_en.text: Find me a skill for generating changelogs.
say_en.note: It will search and recommend skills with install commands.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for React performance optimization?
say_en.note: It checks the leaderboard first, then gives filtered suggestions.

say_en.text: Install it for me once found.
say_en.note: It runs npx skills add to install it.
